frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root ف و ه denotes the mouth — the concrete external oral aperture of the face, the boundary-organ between interior (heart/belly) and exterior through which intake passes in (water: 13:14), emission of speech/breath/manifested states passes out (18:5, 3:118, 61:8/9:32), and which can be physically sealed (36:65). It is a neutral, purely nominal body-part noun; it carries no lexical charge of speech-content, truth, falsity, insincerity, or externality-as-such.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every occurrence of fwh means the physical mouth. Sometimes it is a plain body part (water reaching the mouth in 13:14; hands to mouths in 14:9; mouths sealed in 36:65), and very often it is the aperture from or with which speech issues (words come 'out of' mouths in 18:5; people say things 'with their mouths' in 3:167, 5:41, 9:8, 24:15, 33:4, 9:30; they try to blow out God's light 'with their mouths' in 61:8, 9:32). The frequent hypocrisy/insincerity flavor is not in the word fwh itself: it is built every time by an explicit contrast term — heart (qalb), breast (sadr), knowledge (ilm), or God's truth (haqq). Strip that contrast and the mouth reverts to a neutral organ, as the drinking and gesture verses prove.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: fwh is NOT speech/utterance (qawl and kalima co-occur as distinct items: 33:4 قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ, 9:30 قَوْلُهُم بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ, 18:5 كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ). NOT the tongue/articulator lisān (distinguished in one verse, 24:15 بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ … بِأَفْوَاهِكُم). NOT the interior cavity jawf (distinguished in one verse, 33:4 جَوْفِهِۦ … بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ). NOT the heart/breast qalb/sadr — it is systematically their manifest/outer counterpart (3:118, 3:167, 5:41, 9:8). It does NOT inherently entail falsity, insincerity, or futility (neutral proof: 13:14 water, 14:9 gesture, 36:65 sealing). It does NOT extend to a verb — the root is purely nominal (N ×13).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 61:8:5:2 and 9:32:6:2 «يُرِيدُونَ … يُطْفِـُٔوا۟ نُورَ ٱللَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ» ('to extinguish God's light with their mouths'): 'mouths' is metonymic for breath/propaganda — you do not literally blow out light with a mouth — which could be read as drifting toward a non-organ 'utterance/breath' sense. It does not break the account: the trope depends on the literal image of feeble breath issuing from the mouth-aperture, so it exploits the organ rather than abandoning it; it confirms the aperture-of-emission nucleus and forces no second sense.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The enriched nucleus: 'fwh = the organ/locus of external, merely-verbal, insincere speech opposed to inner reality.' Tempting because 8 of 13 tokens are بأفواههم in contexts of empty/false/futile claiming and four explicitly oppose mouth to heart/breast. It is refuted Quran-internally by 13:14 (فَاهُ = a mouth water fails to reach, zero verbal/inner content), 14:9 (hands into mouths, a gesture), and 36:65 (mouth physically sealed). The insincerity is supplied every time by an explicit contrast term (قلوب 3:167/5:41/9:8, صدور 3:118, علم 24:15, الحق 33:4), not by fwh. The concrete-organ account is strictly narrower and covers all 13; the enriched account covers at most 8. Concrete-organ wins.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three analysts independently confirm a single concrete nucleus 'mouth' covering 13/13, morphologically uniform (one lexeme, sing. فاه / pl. أفواه; no meaning-bearing form variation; no verbal branch). Distinctiveness is established by explicit same-verse internal contrasts against lisān (24:15), jawf (33:4), and qalb/sadr, plus separation from qawl/kalima — this rules out nearest competitors rather than vaguely fitting everything. The account is adversarially clean: the sole tempting resistant pattern (بأفواههم 'insincerity') is compositional, not lexicalized, so there is NO coherent resistant sub-class — the STRONG bar is met. Analyst C's proposed MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE is declined: its grounds are (a) that plain denotation is 'uninteresting' — irrelevant to evidential strength — and (b) collocational skew, which caps only the enriched claim (already rejected) and does not touch the concrete claim, whose non-بـ tokens (13:14 intake, 14:9 into, 18:5/3:118 out-of, 36:65 upon) independently vary the construction. UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION is warranted because the claim holds for every occurrence with no unbridged class.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) each concluded the concrete 'mouth' nucleus is over-determined and could not be disproven; all three refuted the enriched-speech reading using the same non-verbal anchors.
candidate_root_contribution: The root ف و ه denotes the mouth — the concrete external oral aperture of the face, the boundary-organ between interior (heart/belly) and exterior through which intake passes in (water: 13:14), emission of speech/breath/manifested states passes out (18:5, 3:118, 61:8/9:32), and which can be physically sealed (36:65). It is a neutral, purely nominal body-part noun; it carries no lexical charge of speech-content, truth, falsity, insincerity, or externality-as-such.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13 confirmed tokens, all QAC-tagged N: singular فاه (faA) at 13:14:18:1 and plural أفواه at the other 12, spanning 8 surahs and both Meccan (13,14,18,36,61) and Medinan (3,5,9,24,33) contexts.
layer_attribution.derivation: Morphologically uniform single lexeme with only a singular/plural surface split that tracks number of bearers, not sense; no meaning-bearing form variation and no verbal branch anywhere.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One monosemous concrete nominal nucleus: 'mouth = external oral aperture.' No lexicalized sub-class exists; the بأفواههم 'insincerity' pattern is a compositional frame effect, not a distinct lexical class.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The hypocrisy/futility coloring in the بـ tokens is contextual/narrative: it is produced by the instrumental بـ plus an explicit inner-faculty contrast (قلب, صدر, علم, الحق) and by verbs of saying — this is a property of the frame and must NOT be read into the root.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Analysts A and B (STRONG) and adversary C (MODERATE) agreed on the concrete nucleus and on rejecting the enriched claim; the grade is reconciled to STRONG/UNIVERSAL because C's downgrade targeted only claim novelty and collocational skew, neither of which weakens the evidential support for the concrete claim, which has no coherent resistant sub-class.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: None at the lexeme level. The only residual is pragmatic: the specific gesture in 14:9:24:1 is underdetermined by co-text, and 61:8/9:32 are organ-grounded metonymy — neither resists the 'mouth' account nor constitutes a resistant seam.

evidence_basis.statement: In 14:9:24:1 the referent 'mouths' is the physical organ and is lexically secure; only the gesture's meaning is underdetermined, which is pragmatic, not lexical, uncertainty.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence finally resists the concrete 'mouth' account, so there are no RESISTANT_SEAM cases and counterevidence_refs is empty. The logged hard cases are genuine adversarial boundaries (61:8/9:32 metonymy toward 'breath/utterance') and a structural atypicality (14:9 pragmatically opaque gesture); each is resolved in favor of the organ sense, with its evidence statement mirrored in strongest_counterexample or a cluster/override note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: The universal claim 'fwh = the concrete mouth/oral aperture' would be rejected if an occurrence were found where fwh must denote something other than the physical mouth — e.g. an utterance/speech-content itself independent of the organ, an inner faculty, or the tongue-as-articulator — such that no organ reading is coherent.
rejection_condition.search_location: Re-examine the metonymic instrumental tokens 61:8:5:2 and 9:32:6:2 and the qawl/kalima co-locations 33:4:22:2, 9:30:13:2, 18:5:12:1, where a drift from organ to utterance would first surface.
rejection_condition.verification_method: For each candidate, test whether substituting the concrete 'mouth-aperture' referent renders the verse incoherent while an abstract 'utterance/faculty' referent is required; confirm against the neutral physical anchors 13:14:18:1, 14:9:24:1, 36:65:4:1.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Distinguish root-borne meaning from frame-borne effect: strip the instrumental بـ and the explicit contrast term (قلب/صدر/علم/الحق) and check whether any insincerity or 'utterance' sense survives in fwh alone; a sense that disappears with the frame is compositional, not lexical.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such an occurrence is confirmed, the monosemous universal claim collapses to REPRESENTATIVE or splits into a multi-class result, and the STRONG grade is withdrawn.

reopen_conditions: If a reviewed segment-level Arabic alignment or corpus expansion surfaces a fwh token where the mouth-organ reading is impossible and an abstract 'utterance/faculty' reading is forced — especially any new بأفواههم token lacking an explicit heart/knowledge/truth contrast that still carries insincerity.
If the metonymy in 61:8:5:2 / 9:32:6:2 is shown by further internal parallels to lexicalize 'breath/speech' as a distinct sense separable from the organ, warranting a second cluster.
If a verbal or derived (non-N) form of the root is attested anywhere in the corpus, since the current account depends on fwh being purely nominal.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The enriched 'insincere-speech nucleus' competitor was actively tested and refuted by 13:14, 14:9, and 36:65 (pure physical uses with no verbal/inner content), while the concrete 'mouth' claim survives every occurrence. Distinctiveness is affirmed by explicit same-verse contrasts against lisān (24:15), jawf (33:4), and qalb/sadr, ruling out nearest neighbours. No occurrence fails; the claim is genuinely falsifiable (a required-non-organ token would break it) and no such token exists.
